description: This file contains unit tests for the PerformanceTrackerDao class within the OrangeHRM performance plugin; it tests methods related to performance tracker data access, including saving, updating, and reviewer checks.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PerformanceTrackerDao, testing its methods for handling performance tracker data, including transaction handling and reviewer checks.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of PerformanceTrackerDao and populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testSavePerformanceTrackerWithTransactionException
methods.description: Tests that savePerformanceTracker throws a TransactionException when the underlying persist method throws a generic Exception.

methods.name: testIsTrackerReviewerWithNullEmpNumber
methods.description: Checks that isTrackerReviewer returns false when given a null employee number.

methods.name: testUpdatePerformanceTrackerWithEmptyReviewerArray
methods.description: Verifies that updatePerformanceTracker correctly handles an empty reviewer list and returns the original entity.
